definitions.gloss: huge success, great success, smashing success
definitions.explanation: An extremely successful outcome, much beyond ordinary success. Compound of {大|だい} (big, great) and {成功|せいこう} (success).

examples.japanese: イベントは{大成功|だいせいこう}だった。
examples.english: The event was a huge success.

examples.japanese: {新製品|しんせいひん}の{発売|はつばい}は{大成功|だいせいこう}に{終|お}わった。
examples.english: The launch of the new product ended in great success.

examples.japanese: {大成功|だいせいこう}を{収|おさ}めた。

notes:
COMPOUND: {大|だい} (big, great) + {成功|せいこう} (success)

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {大成功|だいせいこう}を{収|おさ}める (achieve great success)
- {大成功|だいせいこう}に{終|お}わる (end in great success)
- {大成功|だいせいこう}だった (was a huge success)

SIMILAR COMPOUNDS WITH {大|だい}:
- {大失敗|だいしっぱい} (huge failure)
- {大問題|だいもんだい} (big problem)
- {大発見|だいはっけん} (great discovery)
- {大人気|だいにんき} (great popularity)
